- [pending] Prevent paid customers’ dunning reminders in `ledgerly/dunning/scheduler.py`.

- [pending] Diagnose search rebuild failures; baseline command: `pytest -q tests/search/test_index.py` (18 passed, 2 failed).
- [constraint] Keep commits small. Integration jobs must use `ci-runner-arm64`, not retired `ci-runner-small`. No Celery task below 400 successful executions/sec with zero timeouts. Do not edit `tests/conftest.py` without `#ledgerly-tests` approval from `@mira`.

## Recent work
Webhook retries now cover transport and retryable server errors, with bounded backoff and immediate client-error failure. Search inspection found paginated invoice rebuilds and per-document embedding serialization, a likely bottleneck causing stale descriptions.
